What is included

Every package at a glance

Full board

Moroccan, French, and Italian cuisine — three cuisines, a thousand flavours — included in all four packages.

Activities programme

Seven worlds of experience — nature, culture, crafts, cooking, wellbeing, creativity, and adventure.

Personal support

Daily team for daily living, social life, and peace of mind — plus coordination with external healthcare professionals.

65 m² per room

40 m² living space plus 25 m² private terrace — generous personal space in an intimate twelve-room residence.

Waiting list

Twelve rooms — considered admission

With only twelve rooms, places are limited. Admission is managed through a waiting list, allowing families and future residents time to prepare and arrive without rush.

Many families begin with a Discovery Stay — three months to experience Maison Calista with no obligation — before choosing Well-Being, Comfort, or Signature for the longer term.
